synopsis: ASAM OpenSCENARIO XML 1.4.0 is dated 2026, with a secondary listing reporting June 2026 [f7149]. It describes precise, synchronized maneuvers tied to road networks and shares a road-traffic domain model with OpenSCENARIO DSL and OpenDRIVE [f14485, f7150, f6691]. The booklet rates its fit for off-road work without roads or lanes as poor to moderate; world-coordinate placement is possible, but terrain and slopes must come from external assets [f7150, f7151]. XML and OpenDRIVE nevertheless have broad tool support, including VTD, dSPACE, CARLA, RoadRunner, Prescan and MORAI; that interoperability does not resolve the stated off-road modeling limitations [f8616, f7150, f7151].

relations.note: Both describe road-network-bound maneuvers and poor-to-moderate off-road fit.
Adds a secondary June listing to the glossary's 2026 version date.
The road-traffic domain model explains road-network dependence and limited off-road fit.
Clarifies world-coordinate capability and the need for external terrain and slope assets.
Road-centric modeling explains limitations for off-road work without roads or lanes.
World-coordinate placement is possible, but terrain and slopes remain external.
